meta.title: DSE 經濟科答題骨架
meta.subject: DSE econ
meta.note: 原創答題步驟，不是考評局評卷參考的原文。

skeletons.title: 自身價格變了：沿線移動
skeletons.whenToUse: 題目只改該物品的價格，其他因素明言不變。
steps: 寫 ceteris paribus，指出變的是自身價格。
說這是 quantity demanded 或 quantity supplied 的改變，不是曲線移動。
沿原線指出新的一點，並說明價格與數量的方向。
sentenceFrames: 因為只有自身價格由 P1 升到 P2，需求曲線不變，數量需求沿曲線由 Q1 減到 Q2。
skeletons.trap: 寫成 demand decreases。那會被當成整條曲線左移。

skeletons.title: 非價格因素：移動需求或供應
skeletons.whenToUse: 收入、相關物品價格、口味、預期、成本或技術改變。
steps: 點名是哪一個決定因素，以及它影響需求還是供應。
說明曲線左移還是右移，並給一句原因。
讀出新均衡價格和數量；若兩邊一起移動，寫明哪一個結果未能確定。
sentenceFrames: 茶與咖啡是代替品。茶價上升使咖啡的需求曲線右移，均衡價格和數量上升。
skeletons.trap: 兩條曲線都移動時，仍硬寫價格和數量同時上升。

skeletons.title: 價格上限或下限是否生效
skeletons.whenToUse: 題目給出管制價格，要你判斷短缺、過剩或沒有影響。
steps: 先寫自由市場均衡，再比較管制價在均衡之上還是之下。
上限低於均衡才生效，出現短缺；下限高於均衡才生效，出現過剩。
成交量取較短的一邊，不要用價格差距代替數量差距。
sentenceFrames: 上限低於均衡價格，所以生效。在該價格，數量需求大於數量供應，差額是短缺。
skeletons.trap: 把不生效的上限也畫成短缺。

skeletons.title: 從量稅：稅楔與無謂損失
skeletons.whenToUse: 題目問稅負、稅收或效率損失。
steps: 畫出買家支付的價格和賣家實收的價格，差距等於每單位稅。
稅收是兩價之間、直到新產量的長方形，屬轉移。
無謂損失是不再成交、但買家估值仍高於賣家成本的三角形。
sentenceFrames: 需求較無彈性的一方承擔較多稅負。稅收不是無謂損失。
skeletons.trap: 把政府收到的稅全部塗成 deadweight loss。

skeletons.title: 計算 PED 或 YED
skeletons.whenToUse: 題目給兩個價格或兩份收入，以及對應數量。
steps: 寫出百分比改變，並註明用最初值做基數。
PED 取絕對值再判斷大於、等於或小於 1。
YED 保留正負號：正數是正常物品，負數是劣等物品。
sentenceFrames: 數量改變百分之 a，價格改變百分之 b，所以 |PED| = a/b。
skeletons.trap: 因為 PED 是負數就說需求無彈性，或把它說成劣等品。

skeletons.title: 機會成本與經濟成本
skeletons.whenToUse: 題目出現自有舖位、自僱而不支薪，或放棄了的選擇。
steps: 分開顯性成本（真正付款）和隱性成本（放棄的收入）。
經濟成本等於兩者之和。
若會計利潤為正但經濟利潤為負，寫明資源用在別處更好。
sentenceFrames: 店主不支薪，但放棄了在別處可賺的工資，所以經濟成本高於會計成本。
skeletons.trap: 沒有發票就說成本是零。

skeletons.title: 短期成本曲線
skeletons.whenToUse: 題目改固定成本或可變成本，或問 MC 與 ATC 的交點。
steps: 固定成本改變只移動 ATC／AFC，不移動 MC 和 AVC。
可變投入價格改變會移動 MC、AVC 和 ATC。
MC 在 AVC 和 ATC 的最低點與其相交。
sentenceFrames: 租金上升是固定成本上升，MC 不變，所以 MR = MC 的產量不變，但利潤下降。
skeletons.trap: 一看到成本上升就把 MC 上移。

skeletons.title: 廠商利潤最大化
skeletons.whenToUse: 任何市場結構問產量或價格。
steps: 先畫該廠商面對的需求。完全競爭是水平線，單一價格的壟斷是向下斜、MR 在需求之下。
產量定在 MR = MC。
價格從需求曲線讀，不是從 MR 與 MC 的交點讀。
sentenceFrames: 壟斷者在 MR = MC 的產量生產，再按需求曲線收取高於 MR 的價格。
skeletons.trap: 把壟斷的產量定在需求曲線與 MC 相交之處。那是效率產量，不是利潤產量。

skeletons.title: 長期自由進入
skeletons.whenToUse: 完全競爭或壟斷性競爭的長期均衡。
steps: 正經濟利潤引致進入，廠商面對的需求被分薄。
長期均衡是經濟利潤為零，不是會計利潤為零。
完全競爭下，價格等於 ATC 的最低點。
sentenceFrames: 自由進入使經濟利潤降至零。廠商仍覆蓋機會成本，所以不是關門。
skeletons.trap: 看到零經濟利潤就說廠商應該停產。

skeletons.title: 名目 GDP、實質 GDP 與不計入的項目
skeletons.whenToUse: 題目給名義增長和物價，或問某筆款項算不算 GDP。
steps: 名義 GDP 用當期價格；實質 GDP 用基期價格，先把物價分開。
轉移支付沒有換取生產，不計入；教師薪酬和新建住宅要計。
GDP 是境內生產。問居民收入時才轉到 GNP 或境外淨要素收入。
sentenceFrames: 名義 GDP 上升 6%、平減指數也上升 6%，實質產量大致不變。老人現金津貼是轉移支付，不是額外 GDP。
skeletons.trap: 把名義升幅全部寫成產量上升，或把轉移支付加進政府開支。

skeletons.title: Demand and supply shift essay
skeletons.whenToUse: A question gives a new circumstance and asks for a new equilibrium.
steps: Define the market and state the original equilibrium price and quantity.
Identify the shock and say which curve shifts, and why, naming the determinant.
Draw a labelled demand-supply diagram with the original equilibrium marked.
Show the new curve and the new equilibrium, with P and Q compared to before.
Comment on any surplus or shortage that appears as the price adjusts.
Add a short elasticity comment if the question asks for evaluation.
sentenceFrames: 因為只有 {determinant} 改變，所以 {curve} 由 {位置} 移向 {位置}，新均衡價格由 {P1} 變為 {P2}。
skeletons.trap: Forgetting ceteris paribus, or mixing a slide along a curve with a shift of the curve.

skeletons.title: Elasticity application
skeletons.whenToUse: A question gives two prices and quantities, or asks whether a good is elastic.
steps: Name the elasticity and write the formula with the right variables.
State the percentage base, or say that you are using the midpoint method.
Compute the value and interpret the sign and the size against 1.
Link it to total revenue, or to who bears a tax, depending on the question.
State any assumption about the time period or the availability of substitutes.
sentenceFrames: PED = (%ΔQd)/(%ΔP) = {值}，所以需求屬於{彈性}，因為 |PED| {大於／小於} 1。
skeletons.trap: Treating the slope as elasticity, or dropping the sign when the question is about YED or XED.

skeletons.title: Price control evaluation
skeletons.whenToUse: A question asks you to assess a ceiling, a floor or a minimum wage.
steps: Decide whether the control is binding by comparing it with the equilibrium price.
Draw the ceiling or floor line and label the shortage or surplus it creates.
Name the winners and the losers, including how non-price rationing appears.
Add side effects such as queues, black markets, quality cuts or lower investment.
Briefly offer an alternative such as a targeted subsidy or a direct transfer.
sentenceFrames: 因為上限設於均衡價格{以下／以上}，所以{具約束力／不具約束力}，市場出現{短缺／過剩}。
skeletons.trap: Describing a control as binding without checking which side of equilibrium it sits on.

skeletons.title: Tax incidence and deadweight loss
skeletons.whenToUse: A question gives a per-unit tax and asks who pays, or asks about the welfare loss.
steps: Shift supply up by the tax, or draw the wedge, and mark the new quantity.
Label the price buyers pay, the price sellers keep, and the tax rectangle.
Compare consumer and producer surplus before and after the tax.
Identify the deadweight loss triangle between the old and new quantities.
Use relative elasticities to say which side bears more of the burden.
sentenceFrames: 稅由買方與賣方分擔，買方承擔約 {比例}，因為需求較缺乏彈性。
skeletons.trap: Assuming the statutory payer bears the whole tax, or shading the surplus on the wrong side.

skeletons.title: Externality and the policy response
skeletons.whenToUse: A question describes pollution, congestion or a positive spillover and asks what to do.
steps: Classify the externality as negative or positive in production or consumption.
Show the private curve and the social curve, and mark market and social output.
Choose the instrument: a per-unit tax or regulation for a negative externality, a subsidy for a positive one.
Explain that the ideal tax equals the external cost at the socially efficient quantity.
Note practical limits such as measurement difficulty and administrative cost.
sentenceFrames: 由於生產外部成本存在，MSC 大於 MPC，所以市場產量高於社會最有效率產量 {Q*}。
skeletons.trap: Forgetting to say which type of externality applies before proposing a policy.

skeletons.title: Cost curves short answer
skeletons.whenToUse: A question asks you to complete or interpret a set of short-run and long-run cost curves.
steps: Define total cost, total variable cost and total fixed cost for the period.
Derive AVC, ATC and MC from the totals, showing the division and the difference.
Sketch the curves with MC cutting AVC and ATC at their minima.
If asked, add the shutdown and break-even conditions using P against AVC and ATC.
sentenceFrames: MC 由 {Q−1} 增至 {Q} 時的總成本變化，故 MC = {數值}，並在 AVC 與 ATC 的最低點與之交。
skeletons.trap: Claiming MC equals ATC, or drawing AFC rising with output.

skeletons.title: Market structure comparison
skeletons.whenToUse: A question asks you to compare two or more market structures.
steps: Use fixed criteria: number of sellers, product type, barriers to entry, information.
Draw the firm demand and note whether MR equals price or sits below it.
Explain the short-run position where MR = MC and read price from demand.
State the long-run profit outcome given free entry or blocked entry.
Comment on efficiency, comparing price with marginal cost and on product variety.
sentenceFrames: 在完全競爭下，個別廠商面對水平的需求曲線，故 P = MR；而壟斷下 MR 低於 P。
skeletons.trap: Setting P = MC as the monopoly optimum, or forgetting to mention entry barriers.

skeletons.title: GDP measurement critique
skeletons.whenToUse: A question asks how GDP is measured and what it leaves out.
steps: Define GDP as the market value of final goods and services produced domestically in a period.
Explain nominal against real GDP and the role of the deflator.
List what is omitted, such as unpaid household work, informal activity and many environmental costs.
Warn against equating GDP with welfare, and mention that distribution is ignored.
sentenceFrames: 由於未付酬的家庭勞動沒有市場價格，因此 GDP 低估了部分創造福利的活動。
skeletons.trap: Treating a rise in nominal GDP as proof that output or living standards rose.

skeletons.title: AD and AS shock
skeletons.whenToUse: A question gives a macro shock and asks for the effect on prices and output.
steps: Write out the aggregate demand components, C + I + G + (X - M).
Say which curve shifts and which determinant caused it.
Trace the short-run effect on the price level and real output.
Name the type of inflation, distinguishing demand-pull from cost-push.
If asked, add a policy comment, noting lags and the difficulty of offsetting cost-push shocks.
sentenceFrames: 由於 {原因}，{AD／SRAS} 由 {位置} 移向 {位置}，短期內物價{上升／下降}，實質產出{上升／下降}。
skeletons.trap: Naming the inflation type without tying it to which curve shifted.

skeletons.title: Trade and intervention mini essay
skeletons.whenToUse: A question asks about a tariff or another protection measure.
steps: Explain the comparative advantage idea behind trade.
Show the tariff raising the domestic price and reducing imports.
Mark government revenue, the change in consumer and producer surplus, and the loss.
Give one argument for and one against, in terms of the case given.
Avoid slogans: link every argument to a diagram effect or a stated cost.
sentenceFrames: 關稅使國內價格由 {P1} 升至 {P2}，進口量下降，政府取得關稅收入，但消費者剩餘下降。
skeletons.trap: Relying on slogans instead of the diagram, or ignoring the government's revenue rectangle.
